description: Use when a maintenance repair request needs source investigation, reproduction, or a decision whether a minimal candidate and contract-grounded regression test are warranted in an isolated workspace.
planning_instructions: Establish the authoritative behavior, exact source snapshot, and a falsifiable failure explanation before staging a candidate.
Choose the narrowest useful source-tree, exact-file, and isolated-experiment reads for the current uncertainty; focus on the implicated behavior when existing evidence localizes it.
Keep the change minimal and preserve exact base-file digests so concurrent or out-of-scope source changes fail closed.

Create a regression test that reaches the intended assertion on the baseline and runs unchanged with the candidate. Before claiming reproduction, inspect the named failing assertion in the baseline artifact or a trusted verification receipt explicitly confirming that expected test; a nonzero exit alone can also mean a setup, compilation, or unrelated test failure.
Use profile-defined experiments for focused questions and owner-defined verification for the candidate's final execution evidence.

Choose no_change when inspected evidence supports the existing behavior, not_reproduced when an adequate reproduction attempt did not reproduce the claimed failure, and inconclusive when a material prerequisite remains unavailable or conflicting.
response_instructions: Report only candidate, test, verification, job, and artifact identities returned by tools, with pending or failed execution states stated explicitly.

State what source and contract content was inspected and what reproduction was actually attempted. Use no_change only with evidence supporting existing behavior; use not_reproduced only with a meaningful reproduction attempt, and inconclusive for missing evidence or an investigation blocked before reproduction.
tool_hints: For the repair investigation itself, consider maintenance-source-tool/read_source_file, search_source, and list_source_tree to inspect the applicable contract and implementation. Another agent's propose_maintenance_change or review_maintenance_change is delegation, not a source read or local repair operation.

When an isolated experiment or candidate is warranted, consider maintenance-workspace-tool/create_workspace for the admitted snapshot, run_experiment for a profile-approved experiment, and stage_candidate for proposed changes and regression tests. Select according to the current question and each capability's required inputs.

For an actual candidate needing execution evidence, consider maintenance-workspace-tool/run_verification; get_job and read_job_artifact can resolve pending state or inspect terminal output. A verification request requires an existing candidate and does not itself establish passing checks.

Connect capability calls with their documented direct outputs, preserving the request's case, observation, repository, snapshot, and workspace-profile identities without substituting unrelated digests or nested objects.

resources.name: candidate-checklist
resources.description: Checklist for staging a reviewable repair candidate.
resources.load_when: Load when evidence supports staging source changes and a regression test.
resources.content: Bind every existing file to the content SHA-256 returned by its exact source read; use the capability's documented absent-file marker for a new path. Keep source changes separate from regression-test changes and provide only the exact declared test-function name as the expected test. Preserve protected configuration and tests. A staged candidate is not verified: request owner-defined verification when returning a candidate, retain its direct handles, and treat pending, truncated, timed-out, setup-failed, assertion-failed, and successful outcomes as distinct facts.

should_activate: Propose a minimal fix and regression test for this reproduced order-total defect.
Inspect this snapshot and stage a bounded candidate if the contract violation is supported.
should_not_activate: Publish the approved candidate as a draft pull request.

change_reason: Keep patch-specific guidance optional and consume shared log and pending-job rules from always-required maintenance-safety
